chunks.text:
Formation of the Solar System
Around 4.6 billion years ago, the Solar System formed from a cloud of gas and dust.

Accretion of Planetary Bodies
Planetesimals collided and stuck together, forming the early planets.

The Hadean Eon
The Earth was extremely hot with a molten surface and frequent asteroid impacts.

Formation of the Moon
A Mars-sized body collided with Earth, and debris formed the Moon.

The Archean Eon
The Earth's crust cooled and oceans formed; early microbial life appeared.

The Proterozoic Eon
Oxygen started to accumulate in the atmosphere; more complex life forms evolved.

The Phanerozoic Eon
Major diversification of life occurred, including the Cambrian Explosion.

Age of Dinosaurs
Dinosaurs dominated the planet during the Mesozoic era.

Planet History
Earth experienced several mass extinctions that reshaped life.

Rise of Mammals and Humans
After the dinosaurs, mammals thrived, eventually leading to the rise of humans.
